ns2:section.sectionText: All content will be delivered online in an asynchronous manner. There will be no synchronous class meetings, however there will be 2 synchrounous exams. This course will be taught on the Coursera platform. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
